title: Admissible condensed coefficient ring
statement: A condensed ring $\Lambda$ [sk-def-sfb-ring-object], in the universe convention [def-weil-size-convention], is an admissible coefficient ring if for some prime $\ell$ it is isomorphic as a condensed ring to a finite commutative discrete ring $A$ with $\ell^n A=0$ for some $n\geq0$, to $\mathbf Z_\ell$ or $\mathbf Q_\ell$ with their usual topologies, to $\mathcal O_E$ or $E$ for a finite subextension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ of an algebraic closure with its induced ell-adic topology, or to the condensed algebraic closure $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ whose sections are continuous functions valued in a finite subextension. Isomorphism here includes the unit and multiplication.

source.place: opening hypotheses of the stratum Hom lemma
